excludedConfigBearingCapabilities.reason: Hyprland autostart is arbitrary process execution inside a hyprland.start callback. Persisting shell commands cannot provide closed typing, idempotence, provenance, transactional rollback, or safe preview; managed user services or reviewed components are the supported ownership boundary.

Raw hl.exec_cmd, hl.exec_raw, and unrestricted command-bearing actions can execute arbitrary code and mutate state outside the compositor transaction. Settings supports only the closed reviewed binding/action and typed rule catalogs.

Custom Lua functions, event callbacks, timers, required modules, and runtime-generated configuration are executable programs rather than declarative desired state; they cannot be safely diffed, validated, rendered, or rolled back by this settings authority.

Hyprland plugins are native shared objects loaded into the compositor process with broad internal access. Their installation trust, ABI/version pinning, build commands, lifecycle, and dynamic plugin-defined namespaces are outside the closed 0.56.2 Settings catalog.
